title: I built a tiny 8-bit browser game called Neon Drift
author: ScriptLurker
selftext:
Neon Drift is a fast, one-more-run arcade game built around one simple mechanic: move left or right across five lanes.

Collect the glowing blue orbs, dodge the pink mines, and keep your combo alive for increasingly large score multipliers. Gold orbs are worth extra points, while narrowly slipping past a mine earns a close-call bonus.

The longer you survive:

* The game gets faster
* Obstacles appear more frequently
* Patterns become harder to read
* Maintaining a combo becomes more valuable

I used AI as a rapid game-development partner throughout the process. I started with the goal of making an extremely simple but addictive browser game, then used AI to help shape the core loop, write the HTML/CSS/JavaScript, implement the scoring and difficulty systems, and add details like particles, screen shake, sound effects, and an  8-bit soundtrack. I directed the concept and iterations. 

The finished game runs inside a self-contained HTML file. High scores are saved locally in the browser.

Controls: **Arrow keys or A/D** on desktop, and on-screen buttons or tapping either side of the screen on mobile.

Play it here: [**https://neondrift.vibegamez.win**](https://neondrift.vibegamez.win/)
